name: world-heritage-portal
description: UNESCO World Heritage Centre database portal — Express API (apps/api) + React/Vite frontend (apps/web).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green -k "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:init && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup
